Methods on this site are tools in service of questions. Each section links to the investigations where the method is actually used.

<!-- TODO: for each area, 2–3 sentences on what you use it for and WHY — then link to the pages that use it. Fill these in only as real work exists. -->

## Quantitative imaging & radiomics

DCE-MRI handling, segmentation masks, feature extraction (PyRadiomics), robustness to segmentation and preprocessing.

## Transcriptomics & prognostic modelling

Module discovery, signature scoring, survival analysis (Cox models, nomograms), calibration and decision-curve analysis.

## Spatial transcriptomics

Visium QC, compartment definition, pathway and signature scoring, spatial association analysis.

## Reproducibility

Every investigation has a public repository with code, environment specification and a link to the source data.
